items: Hello Adventurers! We're back with yet another Major Update - tomorrow, we release the Umbral Sands!
We're also on sale from
NOW
until June 25th, at 30% off!

Explore an entire new region, inspired by the iconic deserts of mainland Gielinor, and battle across the desert with its dynamic weather systems, seeking shelter, shade and shadow to progress! Battle your way through the Fight Cave to earn the right to challenge Fuzan, and return to the Fight Cave to repeat the challenge for more rewards including rare materials and rewards. Yew, Adamant and Red Dragonhide crafting materials are available, allowing you to craft an additional tier of gear, alongside powerful Vestiges for each combat style.

There's going to be new bosses for you to take on including Fuzan, the new Dragon General, but Fuzan is not alone. Amongst other named bosses, you'll also be able to find keys to access the Nightmare Crucible, a challenging arena that throws the worst of Ashenfall at you.

Form a fragile alliance with the scattered tribes of the Moon Garou, aided by the Jackal-headed God of the Underworld, Icthlarin! Complete quests for the Garou to earn access to new resources, rewards and cosmetics.
Steam Achievements are here! At last, you get another bar to fill and another number to go up.
Woodcutting and Mining Skill Trees will be filled out to 99 with new spells, recipes, perks and rewards!
We've got tons of new music, ambience and soundscapes for your listening pleasure, so don't touch that dial now, we're just getting started.
Let's dive into what's coming in -
spoilers
ahead, so tread carefully.
New Features
The Umbral Sands region has been added. Fell the Black Knight Titan to pass beyond the gates and enter the Umbral Sands...
3 new vaults have been added in the Umbral Sands region.
Environmental hazards have been added:

Sunscorch: Prolonged exposure to the sun will wither you away. The Scorch debuff, once applied, causes hydration to deplete rapidly. Build shelter, stick to shade, or adventure in the dawn and dusk to avoid the worst of the Sun's fiery wrath.
Quicksand: Areas of treacherous sand will subsume any poor adventurer who missteps when exploring. You'll need to find a way over these spots.

The Fight Cave has been added. At the end of the questline, you will be able to take on the Fight Cave to challenge Fuzan. Earn your reward and bring down the last obstacle between you and the Dragon Queen, Kuldra.
New Items
Adamant Ore has been added, and with it, new items.
4 New Tools:
Spade

Pickaxe
Logging Axe
8 New Weapons:
Crossbow

Added 3 New Weapons

Yew Stock for Crossbow

Added Infinity Robes

Added Red Dragonhide armour.
4 Vestige Armour Sets have been added to the game:
Magic:
Lunar Garou
Desert Robes
Ranged:
Kalphite Carapace
Melee:
Obsidian
New Buildings
We talked about this in a newspost recently in more detail! Your crafting stations will be deleted on login and you will need to replace them - your components will be refunded.
Blacksmith's Bench - Tools and Melee Weapons
Fletching Bench - All Ranged Weaponry
Mystic Forge - Magic weapons and Vestiges
Armour Bench - All armour sets
Ore & Stone Storage - Unlocked at Mining Level 59
Lumber Storage - Unlocked at Woodcutting Level 59
Additional Kharidian Building Pieces have been added.
New Enemies
Added the following Bosses and Mini-bosses:
Fuzan
Tok-Xil
Red Dragon
The Kalphite Queen
Added the following enemies:
Kalphites:
Kalphite Worker
Kalphite Solider
Kalphite Guardian
KotHaar:
KotHaar-Xil
KotHaar-Kal
KotHaar-Ket
Wildlife:
Desert Kebbit
Goat
Vulture
Steam Achievements
There's a heap of new achievements being added! We're not spoiling the list for you, but there's more to come with later updates. For now, enjoy the 43 (
fourty-three!
) achievements to dig into. Good luck, adventurers.
New Skill Progression for Mining and Woodcutting
Mining has been populated from levels 50-99.
New Spell  51- Divine Rock :
Turn 5 ore on the ground into a personal mining vein for your continued use.
Recipe 59 - Ore &  Stone Storage:
Unlocks Ore & Stone Storage building piece for you to stash your goodies.
Perk 69 - Ultimate Burst:
Increased Rocksplosion area of effect. Nice.
Perk 71- Accelerated Veins:
Chance for Divine Rock (Level 51) to drop gemstones.
Perk 74 - Ingot Weight Reduction:
Reduces the weight of ingots by 50%
Woodcutting has been populated from levels 50-99.
New Spell 52 - Trunk Totem:
Transmute scattered trees into a single totem.
Recipe 59 - Lumber Storage:
New buildable piece with high storage capacity for logs & planks.
Perk 67 - Wood Weight Reduction:
Reduce the carry weight of wood by 50%.
Recipe 78 - Lumber Backpack:
Increases woodcutting XP, increases rare drop chances and reduces wood weight when worn. You guys wanted a backpack, right?
Perk 88 - Axtral Projection Upgrade:
Upgrades to 3 spectral axes for bigger Area of Effect. Chop chop!
The Nightmare Crucible

Chills. Anyway, find Engrams around the Umbral Sands to gain access to the Nightmare Crucible, an ancient Dragonkin experiment pitting you against the biggest and baddest monsters Ashenfall can throw at you. This challenge, boss-rush style mode will pit you against enemies and reward you with rare rewards -

, which will be used for powerful upgrades ahead of the Scorned Wilderness' release.

body.text: Raid and movement lines
Agility
body.author: Jagex · 0.12.1

body.text: With the 0.12.1 release, we're delighted to be introducing a long-overdue addition to RuneScape: Dragonwilds - Agility! Our latest skill will allow you to build up your stamina and sculpt yourself into a speed machine.  Across Ashenfall, you'll find SIX new stations with flags for you to interact with. There, you'll find a leaderboard of times, and a trail of orbs to gather along a fixed course. From there, you'll be able to continually repeat the courses over and over, improving your time, getting XP with every lap.
body.author: Jagex · 0.12.1

body.text: You'll earn rewards for completing Agility courses, and mastery of the courses will net you Gold Medals. You can throw those on your walls, like Pristine Fish from Fishing, as trophies to show everyone who's the boss of the course. Mastering the region's agility course will also grant you a gilded trimmed version of the regional cape as an extra reward.
body.author: Jagex · 0.12.1

body.text: You'll be able to gain XP passively while running across the world, too - but you won't get XP on mounts. Stop cheating and get those knees up! As you level up through the Agility Skill tree, you will passively consume less Stamina while you sprint.
body.author: Jagex · 0.12.1

body.text: You'll also be able to use Agility Shortcuts to make use of Kebbit Burrows situated across the world. items: Agility

With the 0.12.1 release, we're delighted to be introducing a long-overdue addition to RuneScape: Dragonwilds - Agility! Our latest skill will allow you to build up your stamina and sculpt yourself into a speed machine.  Across Ashenfall, you'll find SIX new stations with flags for you to interact with. There, you'll find a leaderboard of times, and a trail of orbs to gather along a fixed course. From there, you'll be able to continually repeat the courses over and over, improving your time, getting XP with every lap.

You'll earn rewards for completing Agility courses, and mastery of the courses will net you Gold Medals. You can throw those on your walls, like Pristine Fish from Fishing, as trophies to show everyone who's the boss of the course. Mastering the region's agility course will also grant you a gilded trimmed version of the regional cape as an extra reward.
Firstly, let's talk about passives:

You'll be able to gain XP passively while running across the world, too - but you won't get XP on mounts. Stop cheating and get those knees up! As you level up through the Agility Skill tree, you will passively consume less Stamina while you sprint.
At levels 50 and 75, you'll also unlock passive increases to your maximum carry weight.

You'll also be able to use Agility Shortcuts to make use of Kebbit Burrows situated across the world. They'll be dotted on your map, and you can dig them up to open up tunnels to cut across side routes in the world. In early Agility levels, you might take damage when failing to squeeze through unharmed, so be careful using the shortcuts on low HP.
At higher levels, you'll start to break your falls from higher up by rolling out of them to avoid taking as much damage. Fatal falls will still kill you though.
The skill tree also, of course, comes with its own Skill Spells and unlocks.
Windstep is now an Agility skill spell, rather than a Runecrafting skill spell.
At higher levels, Windstep will also cause you to send out a blast of air when you land, sending enemies to the floor.
So, you can run further, carry more and scoot across the world in shortcuts. But that's being fast - not agile.
How about... an aerial dash? A short, horizontal dash to cross small gaps and add extra evasive manoeuvres during combat?
Sounds good. What if we gave you... a second jump? You'll be able to jump, jump again in mid-air and then dash horizontally to get over and around enemies. Pretty cool, right?
You'll also be able to use a new skill spell -
Recall

Leave a runic marker on the ground, and then recast to teleport back to the initial marking spot - great for quickly grabbing something urgently and getting out of danger. If you fall to your death while tethered, you'll also teleport back, and the tether will be consumed.

All of this is built to make you faster, leaner and meaner - and we'll be factoring it in moving forwards in how we design exploration, puzzles and more. So don't start thinking you'll be able to make an Agility Pure account - it's time to do some cardio.
The Great Body Robbery

Our longest Secondary Quest to date can be found in Bloodblight Swamp - an unfortunate experiment has rendered the Good* Doctor* Fenkenstrain in a bit of a pickle. You'll need to help him out. Your rewards are a new club weapon that's shockingly good, and a buildable decoration: the Pylon. This functional decoration will generate an area of effect in a radius around it that intercepts lightning strikes to allow you to build in places known for... inclement weather.
* = The validity of this claim is highly disputed.
Combat and Movement Improvements
We're introducing the Ascension Cores feature to the Mystic Forge - use those cores to upgrade Masterwork and Vestige weapons to higher tiers using the relevant cores!
We're adding a radial hotwheel for both Controller and Keyboard + Mouse users to speed up selecting primary items, as well as adding the quick cast shortcut for either a spell OR an item.
Stability changes are coming to make jumping more consistent in suboptimal networking conditions that led to losing the ability to jump in some circumstances.
You'll be able to cycle through your runes/arrows in mid combat to save you having to open your inventory.
Jumping will cost 10 stamina, down from 20 - reducing further when Agility levels are reached.
Leggings of Lightness, Mounts and Windstep should each be unaffected by this, so your general mobility won't change!

We're making good progress on improving performance, additional ambient VFX and tons of optimisation for Fog, trees, grass and even the coastline. All of that is intended to make the experience more stable/smooth for you to focus on what you do best. Smacking the living daylights out of goblins.

We're also adding more to the existing jump to improve its "ledge forgiveness" - as in, if you walk off a ledge, there's a small window of time for you to jump before you cartoonishly plummet to your demise.
Visual Fidelity

We've done a bit of a pass over the starting areas (Brynmoor and Ghornfell) with an emphasis on visual improvements, performance and clarity. We've improved how trees will look nicer at a distance, the visual clarity of moss and fog, our existing grass and foliage to include more flowers, and we've improved performance at lower ends of the settings.
We've revisited night sky visuals, volumetric fog across the world, storm weather visuals and we've also added additional ambient VFX across the region and along the coastline.
Known Issues
Power Level 7 (PL7) Shards do
not
exist in the World, but the recipe to convert PL7 Shards to Cores does exist in the Mystic Forge. This is
not intentional.
We will be removing the recipe with our 1.0 update.
PL7 Cores are
only
obtained from the Nightmare Crucible
directly
and not through converting shards.
Bug Fixes
We're resolving an issue where Axes were dealing incorrect damage to trees.
We misplaced a decimal. Oops!
We'll be reverting this to its intended value with 0.12.1, alongside several other bugfixes to woodcutting, including Splinter and Axetral Projection removing stumps.
This was giving people disproportionate XP based on the damage dealt - we're putting values back to where they should be!
Fixed an issue where Axtral Projection upgrades would not chop down all intended/highlighted trees.
Fixed an issue where Splinter would destroy tree stumps if used on an adjacent log.
Fixed an issue where the Yew Farming Plots did not snap in building modes correctly.
Fixed an issue where Rune Vents would appear full for clients in multiplayer worlds even when depleted.
Fixed an issue introduced in Umbral Sands where game music would loop repeatedly, primarily triggered upon respawning.
Fixed an bug where summoning Buddy in a wall would cause the game to crash.
Get it? Bug? Becau- oh, forget it.
Resolved an issue where a part of the Burning Spire zone where the player could fall through Lava.
Fixed an issue where returning to the main menu after dying would respawn the player back at the location of death.
Fixed an issue where Potion Effects would be removed between game sessions/on logout.
Fixed an issue where Lodestone teleports placed on the edges of the map could only be used one-way as they would fail to be displayed on the map.
Fixed an issue where the search area on the map for the "Saga of the Adventurer" Quest Step was incorrectly aligned.
Fixed an issue where Wild Jade Vines would die to poison in the Toxic Swamp.
Resolved an issue where Ascension Cores weren't displayed correctly in the Mystic Forge of the crafting menu.
Fixed an issue with the TokTz-Mej-Tal staff would not consume runes on attack.
Fixed an issue with some items would display a white square placeholder depiction.
Resolved an issue where the Right Stick on controllers would not turn the camera within a 30% radius in some contexts.
Fixed an issue where some shaded areas would let Scorch stack up to 500% without triggering.
That's probably going to leave a mark.
Tweaked the lighting in the Velgar Arena to improve visibility when fighting him at night.
Fixed an issue where the Spellwheel would not show descriptions for spells as a client in Multiplayer worlds.
Fixed an issue where the Fire Cape would refill Stamina even if the enemy was not afflicted with burns.
Fixed an issue where the Kharidian Inner Corner 45° Stairs would be unclimbable.
Fixed an issue where players could walk under a specific Sand Dune.
Fixed an issue where an Air Anima vent was situated inside a pillar within the Umbral Sands.
Fixed an issue where the Chamber barrier in the Contact! quest would be invisible at very low, low and medium graphics settings.
Fixed an issue with the Special Attack of Hammer weapons which could stunlock Lesser Dragons.
Fixed an issue where the "Shrimp Catcher" quest completion would not contribute to the Achievement "Brynmoor Helper".
Fixed an issue where the Kalphite Queen would respawn in an invisible state after being defeated.
Fixed an issue where the Kalphite Queen's Sting Attack would become angulated.
Fixed an issue where the dunes behind the Kalphite Queen Vault had missing collision.
Fixed an issue where the ground atop the Cave of Screams was missing collission.
Fixed an issue where there was a small invisible barrier blocking pathing in the Dunes of Uzzer when moving on foot.
Fixed an issue where Quicksand and its VFX were showing in areas that weren't actually quicksand.
Fixed an issue where a Sanguine Urn icon was incorrectly placed in the Bloodblight Swamp.
Fixed an issue where users could get stuck in a small spot in the Burning Spire.
Fixed an issue where Desert Weed did not have any healthy growth stage assets when planted. It looks as healthy as it is, now!
Fixed an issue where part of a rock surface in the Burning Spire would behave like lava and damage the player when walking on it.
Fixed an issue where the Menaphite Desert Cape was missing a Journal Entry.
Fixed an issue where the Rapid Growth Skill Spell had a placeholder icon in the Spellbook
Fixed an issue where collision remained on the Zi Core quest item after it had been collected.
Fixed an issue where Korean Subtitles were not showing correctly during the opening cutscene.
Fixed an issue where the Skills Necklace has an unclear description in the interface.
Fixed an issue where Localised text for the Construction Skill bonuses was not displayed correctly.
Fixed an issue where completing a quest for Lagra, Alcarrid's Butcher would not yield rewards if the player's inventory was full.
Fixed an issue with the Yew Shortbow when fully drawn back causing visual clutter.
Fixed an issue where the Fishing Minigame could not have the keybinds rebound.
Fixed an issue where Bones to Peaches would not mention the stack limit is limited to 10.
Fixed an issue where the Blue Dragon was incorrectly labelled as "Lesser Blue Dragon" instead.
Fixed an issue where Stamina would instantly regenerate after jumping when wearing the full set of Wizard Robes.
Fixed an issue with a typo in the Hall of Heroes Journal Entry.
Fixed an issue where Miniaturized Mushrooms in the Dunes of Uzzer could not be gathered.
Fixed an issue where Torches in the doorways in Umbral Sands were unnaturally bright.
Fixed an issue where attempting to cast Fishnado on a Net Fishing Spot would show an incorrect error message: "Your fish has escaped!"
Fixed an issue where Green Dragons' flame attack VFX were not aligned to their mouths properly.

items: [hr][/hr]
"She is here: the pinnacle of dragon creation, the queen, fused with divine blood and now housing the elemental power of my kin." - Rasthin
Hello adventurers!

Our road to the end of Kuldra's Saga is clear. Our 0.12.1 update will be the last stop before we put you face to face with the God-Eater herself. Darkness gathers. Wild magic storms overhead. The only way out is through.

We're going to be sharing a full breakdown of Agility, as well as a Dev Diary condensing 0.12.1's features very soon ahead of it's release at the end of this month. Firstly though, let's talk about Scorned Wilderness.
[img src="][/img]

Until now, we've shipped Major Updates that are expansive continents that add a new region, rich with resources, quests, secrets and lore for you to explore at your own pace. These expansion-like updates have grown the world and set the stage for the adventures you'll be undertaking within it. Scorned Wilderness is
not
like these updates. Scorned Wilderness represents the culmination of our learnings from everything we've built within RuneScape: Dragonwilds so far - but it is
not

the end. Our journey is only beginning, and we're excited to share more about what's coming after Scorned Wilderness once we launch it. Rest assured, our intentions are the same as they always have been - to keep delivering more of the game you love, at a pace that delights and excites you.

We've referred to it so far as a "Raid" because we know that for those of you chasing Twisted Bows, ending up at the toothy end of Zebak, or who've earned the scars from the Liberation of Mazcab, RuneScape Raids
mean
something. We agree.

For those of you unfamiliar with RuneScape raids, we've got you. A Raid is typically a high-end challenge pitched against a player, or groups. You'll be subjected to a gauntlet, delving into a dungeon, raiding a tomb, or... say... charging into an Anima storm to take down a God-Eater. We're the latter. A raid includes unique mechanics or combat challenges testing your mettle and survival skills to hold out against onslaughts of enemies as you fight for a foothold and every inch of ground gained is a victory in itself. Ultimately, you'll rise to the challenge and earn the right to challenge the boss.
Our first
Raid

pits you (and your cadre of adventurer allies, if you so wish) against a landscape that was ripped apart by wild anima, and the fury of Black Dragons. You will traverse across floating islands, fighting through attacks by the God-Eater herself to reach her. Each of her tyrannical, terrible heads channels the fury of Gielinor's dragons - but she is more than the sum of her parts. Those of you who have slain countless Dragons on the Gielinor mainland will recognise some of her attacks. She shares heritage with other Dragonkin experiments,
but she is more
[img src="][/img]

Beyond Kuldra, you'll be able to harvest resources to craft Ancestral Robes, Black Dragonhide gear and of course, Rune Armour. Claim your rewards for a dragon-slaying job well done, and you'll be able to gear yourself up with some new kit that will let you roam the entirety of Ashenfall in relative safety and security. For now, anyway...

Killing Kuldra will ensure you get the latest version of the Dragon Shield as you've come to expect with the previous Dragons, and then a Cape to wear with pride. There is also going to be a selection of pieces of the
iconic
Dragon armour - glorious, resplendent and
red,
including the
Dragon Scimitar
and the
Dragon Crossbow.
There's a few extra secret goodies on that RDT (that's a Rare Drop Table to you and me) that we're not spoiling yet - you'll have to slay that Dragon and get spooned to find them out.

We're excited to keep working on finishing up what is undoubtedly our most vertical, most anima-warped update to date. We're really excited to get it into your hands, and for you to be able to enjoy the entire RuneScape: Dragonwilds experience so far with new combat, new movement, and so much more. With that in mind, while we've aimed to share things early, give you sneak peeks and even some deep dives in things like blog posts, we're going to be making a conscious choice NOT to spoil the Raid.

We'll be sharing more about our work towards the release, including our process for finding and fixing bugs, and the changes we're delivering to change combat and movement from minute one, but the Raid is something else entirely.

It's going to be something you can only experience for the first time once, so we want it to be totally new, and completely engrossing. We hope you can understand, and we're excited to see you taking on the God-Eater when it launches on September 15th.
- The RuneScape: Dragonwilds Team

body.text: Full notes

items: We're making combat less clunky - here's a look at what's coming in our next few updates.

For a long time, we've been listening to feedback around combat - your steam reviews, your comments on Reddit and Discord, and replies on our socials, everywhere! We went back and forth, chatting to hundreds of you, combing through thousands of survey responses, and gathering info. One word kept coming up - clunky! Clunky clunky clunky.
We've boiled it down to some core principles. Here's what we want to address:
Blocking doesn't clearly or consistently reduce damage as expected.
Stamina management is a challenge.
You want to quick-switch and quick-cast more fluidly.
Switching ammo types in combat is punishing.
Weapon Specs should feel stronger, and more impactful to use.
You can't move while casting skill spells.
You want to really punish enemies for parrying them.
Fall damage hurts.
Right - let's fix that. Enter: The
Core Improvements Team.
In our July update, 0.12.1, we'll be deploying the following changes. There's plenty of content, and the Agility skill, too. We won't get into those yet, we want to focus on Combat today.
With the introduction of the Mystic Forge in 0.12, we're adding the functionality to Upgrade Masterworks and Weapons to higher tiers using "Upgrade Cores".
Swapping to a 2H weapon and then back to a 1H weapon will automatically re-equip your off-hand item too.
We're adding a radial hotwheel for both Controller and Keyboard + Mouse users to speed up selecting primary items, as well as adding the quick cast shortcut for either a spell OR an item.

We've had a few reports of players losing the ability to Jump, either due to action inputs going missing, or poor network performance. We've ironed out some creases to make jumping even nicer, as well as the improvements to air control and vertical height already live with 0.12.0.
You'll be able to cycle through your runes/arrows in mid combat to save you having to open your inventory.
Jumping will cost 10 stamina, down from 20 - reducing further when Agility levels are reached.

Fall damage has been rebalanced to start later. As part of the Agility Skill launching with this update, you'll have access to perks that make this even more lenient, as well as a breakfall mechanic that will allow you to absorb damage from higher falls.
Leggings of Lightness, Mounts and Windstep should each be unaffected by this, so your general won't change!

We're making good progress on improving performance, additional ambient VFX and tons of optimisation for Fog, trees, grass and even the coastline. All of that is intended to make the experience more stable/smooth for you to focus on what you do best. Smacking the living daylights out of goblins.

We're also adding more to the existing jump to improve its "ledge forgiveness" - as in, if you walk off a ledge, there's a small window of time for you to jump before you cartoonishly plummet to your demise. There's more to come with agility, but we'll speak to that separately.
But that's not all! With 1.0's release, we're also adding even more:
Camera-relative aiming will become the default controller input.
Where your camera is looking will be where your attacks and spells will go.
This is currently set to where your character is facing, but is a toggle. We're flipping the default, but anyone who has selected an option will keep their preference.
Damage Telegraph Time
Improvements to responsiveness when telegraphing attacks between server and client.
Reducing the number of "phantom hits" you get from just-killed enemies, and making your damage output much more in line with what's on screen.
We're reducing the Block animation and starting the block window earlier, which means you'll be able to block more often, and more effectively.
We're also improving the UI to show the damage mitigated.
We've heard your feedback around casting and switching spells mid-fight. Starting with 0.12.1, you'll be able to
WALK
not run
) during Tempest Shield, Surge, Enchant Weapons and Spectral Arrow skill spell casts.
We're adding extra refinement to camera shake (optional toggle) and feedback on hits.
Players will be able to
attack while sprinting
as a combo opener.
Parrying successfully will grant you 50% of your max stamina back.
Parrying successfully with allow you to land a single, cinematic Visceral Attack, with a camera adjustment so you can savour the satisfying hit.
Stamina costs across weapon types will be rebalanced, as well as shield stamina costs.
You'll be able to
animation cancel
from combat actions.
You'll be able to
animation cancel Skill Spells
by blocking or dodging.
You'll be able to
animation cancel Magic Attacks
by blocking or dodging.
Increased duration of Enchant Weapon and Spectral Arrows
Reduced Cooldown for Tempest Shield and Snare
Early-exit cancels for bow and spell attacks.
Dire Wolf attacks shortened so they can't hit you while fully sprinting away from them.
We're adding 9 enemy variations to Brynmoor, Ghornfell, Fellhollow and Dowdun Reach, with new attacks that will apply debuff effects - poison, shock, wither rot, etc.
Mum Was Right, I Am Special
The Old School RuneScape classic, the Special Attack bar, is also coming to Dragonwilds.

Players familiar with RuneScape will be familiar with how this will work already, but as of 1.0, Special Attacks will consume a portion of the player's special attack bar. This allows us to strengthen some of these attacks and reduce their stamina costs so that they can be more powerful now that we can limit the frequency of these attacks. Your special attack bar will slowly recharge over time meaning players will want to ensure they time their attacks well to get the most out of their limited special attack potential! You will be able to use them less often, but they will feel more powerful with each use. Things like the Titan's Wrath and the Greatsword Special will hit harder, and be more of an active ability choice.
They'll feel less like "another move", and more like a conscious decision to use a Special Ability.
One Hit Wand-er
For 1.0, we're also adding a new magic weapon type... Wands!

Wands are a more mobile, fast-paced way to deal more damage at a comparatively lower damage output. These will still apply buildup of knockdowns, burns and slows that you expect from Air, Fire and Water magic. You'll be able to use wands to move more fluidly in combat and get around, but also hang back with a Staff and lay down more damage if you want!

All of this is in service of making a combat experience that feels truly brilliant, and has been designed around your feedback from the outset. We're so excited to share more with you soon - for now, we hope this is a reassurance that Combat is getting more improvements, and we hope you're excited to get your hands on it soon.

items: Hello again, adventurers. We're closing in on the release of 0.9 on September 9th (0.9 on 9/9!), which includes the Ranged Skill Tree, Creative Mode, Custom World Settings, and some optimisations to a range of features, to boot. For now, we've got a list of lovely fixes and improvements we know you've been asking for, so let's get into those.
[color=#FFED9E]Crafting and Building from Chests[/color]
An oft-requested feature from our community is here! You can now craft and build using nearby chests' contents without requiring the materials in your inventory.
Quest Inventory Update
Garou King's Tokens are now stackable up to 99, and can be destroyed. Special thank-you to u/Narmoth on Reddit who reported this one.
Additional Fixes
Fixed an issue causing the day/night widget to desync when in multiplayer worlds.
Additional work to make the compass more readable.
The compass will now showcase player positions in multiplayer worlds.
Fixed an issue where the Clock Widget would display the wrong time.
Fixed an issue where AMD GPU driver crash may randomly occur when interacting with out of game windows.
Fixed an issue where users who did not have the Fire Magic Perk unlocked could still use Fire magic.

items: Incoming Changes
The Ranged Skill has arrived!
Skill up to Level 50 and enjoy a slate of new Spells, a fletching table for the new sets of arrows, and much more.
Stop your foes in their tracks with the new Snare ability (which is later upgraded to Venomous Trapper!).
Use the new Ability Hunter Sense to gain awareness of nearby foes.
Enchant your bow with Astral Magic, allowing arrows to pierce multiple enemies.
New Archery target buildable
1-Handed Crossbows are here! Now! Along with that, plenty of new bolts to unlock and use.
Tons of other abilities are there to be unlocked, so have a look!
For more information around the ranged skill, check out our blog post “Introducing the Ranged Skill!”.
Creative Mode is now available!
You will need to create a new “Creative Mode” character to access worlds that are Creative Mode enabled.
For those that just want a relaxing, chill and build experience. Check out our blog “Introducing Creative Mode!” with Mod Deluxe for more details.
Custom World Settings
You will need to create a new “Custom World” character to access worlds that are using Custom World settings.
When creating a Custom World, click on Advanced in the upper left to access the World Settings.
Over 40 settings are exposed, from damage, thirst, hunger, to XP rates and processing.
Controller Support (Alpha State)
As mentioned in our blog post last month, “The Road to Fellhollow: A Check-In form our Product Director” with Mod bitf0x, controller support is being updated however we believe it still needs polish.
Players will be able to lock onto enemies, navigate through menus, and we’ve refreshed / reoptimized input bindings.
We’ll be keeping you updated on when we’ll be releasing the next round of polish to make these feel good on the sticks.
Functional Keyboard Rebinding implemented
New multiplayer protections have been added:
Gravestone Protection: A new option in gameplay settings so that other players will not be able to loot your gravestone.
Build Protection Totem: We have added totems with a sphere around them that will prevent other players from building within that area. You will have 8 to place.
Chest Privacy: Chests can now be locked by the owner. Just open the chest and check the box labeled Private.
Updated Character and World List UI
As part of adding Custom Worlds and Creative mode, new icons have been added on character selection and the world selection screens to denote the type of world.
Character Slots increased from 4 to 8.
Antipoison potions have been updated:
Antipoison now uses Marentill rather than Haarlander
Antipoison now resists poison buildup, rather than fully preventing it. This effect stacks with the fungal fortitude buff from certain foods.
The "fungal fortitude" buff from food now fully prevents buildup of poison.
Additional Fixes
Status effects will now persist correctly on reloading
Fixes to places where players or AI could get out of bounds
Floating Rune Essence will be appropriately damaged by secondary staff attacks
Clock widget will now display night correctly for clients
Improvements to desync in AI combat
Ranged projectiles should display correctly
SFX added in multiple places where it was missing
Multiple UI and icon display fixes
Text updates for some incorrect information in quests and the journal
Abyssal Whip special attack will now damage Velgar as expected
AI will no longer attack through Palisade Walls
Clouds are more visible when it is raining
Player waypoints will appear on the compass
Many fixes to foliage clipping through terrain throughout the world
Some improvements to unnatural animations and poses in specific scenarios
Various performance and stability improvements
Known Issues
Controller Support still needs work to get it feeling how we want it to
Custom World Setting values displayed are not always fully accurate
We are tracking the specific settings that are acting up and will hot fix them in the coming weeks.
Host & Clients’ weather state may not be in sync
A restart may be needed immediately on launch, particularly with AMD GPUs
Temporary Freeze when the Protection Totem is first placed in the world
Unlock notifications will incorrectly display for building pieces in Creative Mode

Be sure to join the Official RuneScape: Dragonwilds Discord server to show off your best uses of The Wall™, find parties of dragon-slaying adventurers and chat! Be sure to follow us on our socials, too! We're on Twitter, BSky, Reddit, Instagram, Facebook, Twitch, YouTube and TikTok!

We'll be keeping you updated on when we'll be releasing the next round of polish to make these feel good on the sticks.
Functional Keyboard Rebinding implemented

Gravestone Protection: A new option in gameplay settings so that other players will not be able to loot your gravestone.
Build Protection Totem: We have added totems with a sphere around them that will prevent other players from building within that area. You will have 8 to place.

Character Slots increased from 4 to 8.

The "fungal fortitude" buff from food now fully prevents buildup of poison.

Status effects will now persist correctly on reloading
Fixes to places where players or AI could get out of bounds
Floating Rune Essence will be appropriately damaged by secondary staff attacks
Clock widget will now display night correctly for clients
Improvements to desync in AI combat
Ranged projectiles should display correctly
SFX added in multiple places where it was missing
Multiple UI and icon display fixes
Text updates for some incorrect information in quests and the journal
Abyssal Whip special attack will now damage Velgar as expected
AI will no longer attack through Palisade Walls
Clouds are more visible when it is raining
Player waypoints will appear on the compass
Many fixes to foliage clipping through terrain throughout the world
Some improvements to unnatural animations and poses in specific scenarios
Various performance and stability improvements
Known Issues
Controller Support still needs work to get it feeling how we want it to
Custom World Setting values displayed are not always fully accurate
We are tracking the specific settings that are acting up and will hot fix them in the coming weeks.
Host & Clients' weather state may not be in sync
A restart may be needed immediately on launch, particularly with AMD GPUs
Temporary Freeze when the Protection Totem is first placed in the world
Unlock notifications will incorrectly display for building pieces in Creative Mode

Be sure to join the Official RuneScape: Dragonwilds Discord server to show off your best uses of The Wall™, find parties of dragon-slaying adventurers and chat! Be sure to follow us on our socials, too! We're on Twitter, BSky, Reddit, Instagram, Facebook, Twitch, YouTube and TikTok!

items: Eye on Ashenfall 0.9.2
Quality of Life Changes
RuneScape Dragonwilds version 0.9.2 introduces new quality of life changes whilst being heavily focused on fixing some of our older bugs.
When selecting a skill, it should automatically take you to the current level
Navigating the skills menu, scrolling to level 50… Still scrolling… Give your scroll wheel a rest as clicking on any skill will take the menu to your current level! How was this not always the case?
AI changes throughout the Ghornfell Region
We found some players are having a brutal and frustrating time navigating the Tier 3 content, so we made some initial changes to how AI are working in combat throughout the regions.
• Rangers swap their rapid-fire bows for a more predictable and engaging rate of fire. They also took the scopes off the bows and have a slightly higher chance to miss their shots.
• Rangers have reduced accuracy when the player is engaged in melee combat with other AI.
• Berserkers have less forward momentum.
• Wolves attack less frequently and have been slightly nerfed in their damage output.
• Druids will do reduced poison damage as well as their Nature Fang attack having reduced range, damage and poison application.
More changes to come in future updates!
If you want a more challenging time instead you always have those custom world sliders!
Allow players to Roll when wading through water
Sick of being chased by Goblins through the swampy waters? Tired of spamming jump whilst wading through the shallow waters of the village? Well save that space bar, try rolling through the water!
Introduced a Delay/Grace Period After Respawn to Stop World Events, Base Raids & Hunted Events from Occurring
Goblins and Garou need sleep too!
Bug Fixes
• Using more than 1 Spellbook page will cause attempts to overwrite a filled in spell slot to pick a random spell instead.
• Building totems no longer lose functionally for clients if placed in a solo world and then opened to public.
• Highland Vault & Bloodblight Swamp Vault no longer remain sealed if the user leaves between Lever pulls.
• Characters can now be created when invited via Steam.
• New building or spell notification no longer persists even when read (You can stop reporting it now).
• Tier 2 45 degree roof support now unlocked after meeting prerequisites.
• Mining nodes no longer use bloody hitsplats.
• Hitsplats now show "Bleed" status effect proc.
• Burnt food descriptions added.
• Host can't see client hitsplats any more.
• Crash and Stability fixes.
Enjoy Adventures,
Mod Bakes and the RuneScape Dragonwilds Team

body.text: Raid and movement lines

In April 2025 we launched into Early Access with the first Dragon General, Velgar, and the first two regions: Brynmoor and Ghornfell. We launched with 9 unique skills to level up, unlocking powerful, transformative Skill Spells to make the mundanity of survival a little more magical – no more grinding through countless trees, chopping until the sun comes up. 12 Unique armour sets, across 3 combat styles, supported by a range of weapons up to Iron tier.
body.author: Jagex · 1.0

body.text: In December, our first Major Update “Fellhollow” arrived with the Farming skill, a new building kit, two new NPCs and a shop for trading Soul Fragments with Death himself. Material upgrades brought you the Castle kit to make a spooky stronghold. You can also earn and equip Steel tier gear, complete with its iconic plumed Full Helm, and then made RuneScape history by adding Mounts! Ride a terrorbird and traverse the treacherous terrain in style! The second Dragon boss, Imaru the Revenant Dragon has tested, and will continue to test, the strength of your soul and offers unique rewards for those who grant her finality and peace.
body.author: Jagex · 1.0

body.text: We added three new quests: “Cook’s Assistant”, “Animal Magnetism” and “A Room with a Garou” alongside the Fishing skill which let you catch pristine fish to make new wall-mounted decorative trophies of your finest catches, providing the best healing-per-stack of any food item. We added Auto-run, auto-magnetising nearby items in the world to reduce inputs picking up items around you, the option to hide your helmet to show off your beautiful face and stopped Chickens, Cows and Kebbits from automatically attacking the player unprovoked so you can enjoy your cozy abode or a chill walk around in peace.
body.author: Jagex · 1.0

body.text: Our latest and largest Major Update, Umbral Sands, introduced a new form of Mount – the flying carpet – and introduced you to a region inspired by the Kharidian Deserts of RuneScape. Within this region, we introduced the Kalphite Queen and her brood, Fuzan the Fire Dragon and the Kot’Haar, sentient golems of Obsidian, given life by an Elder Artefact. We also added the Nightmare Crucible, allowing you to earn upgrade materials to power up your favourite weapons from lower Power Levels to be max level to face Kuldra with the release of Scorned Wilderness.  The region allows users to craft Adamant Armour, Red Dragonhide and Infinity Robes as well as additional vestiges including Obsidian Armour, the Obsidian shield and the Fire Cape. We expanded the Skill Trees for Mining and Woodcutting, giving you new Skill Spells and passive rewards, and added more NPC traders for users to trade with.

body.text: Let's talk camera: from the outset, we've had the camera connected very closely to the player. Your movements never strayed too far from your center of the screen. We've added a "deadzone" where you're able to freely roam the middle third of the screen before the camera starts to follow you. This lets you sprint across the world with a little more freedom in your movement and evade in combat without the camera going rogue. This should also help with Agility courses, if you're looking to do your laps.
body.author: Jagex · 1.0

body.text: Parrying will now restore 50% of your max stamina allowing you to quickly turn the tide with a burst of energy if you time it correctly - increasing the risk/reward of timing it just right.

body.text: The camera and parry also allow you to pull off "Visceral Attacks" - a follow-up attack that you can do when you successfully parry and enemy. items: Today marks the start of our next journey. Thank you to the millions (yes, millions!) of you who joined us during Early Access. We're now live on PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, XBOX Series X | S and PC on Epic Games Store, Jagex Launcher and Steam.
Our Early Access Journey

In April 2025 we launched into Early Access with the first Dragon General, Velgar, and the first two regions: Brynmoor and Ghornfell. We launched with 9 unique skills to level up, unlocking powerful, transformative Skill Spells to make the mundanity of survival a little more magical – no more grinding through countless trees, chopping until the sun comes up. 12 Unique armour sets, across 3 combat styles, supported by a range of weapons up to Iron tier.

In June 2025 we expanded our Magic Skill Tree, added additional building pieces including the Palisade Walls for protecting against Base Raids (which we’ve rebalanced and tuned down based on player feedback).

In September we added Ranged skill tree abilities including Hunter Sense, Spectral Arrow and and Snare Skill Spells. We also added poison, barbed and flaming arrows to deal poison, bleed and fire damage, as well as enchanted bolts for Crossbows (including the iconic Blurite Crossbow). We also added the Custom and Creative world options with over 50 custom world setting variables for you to make your world, your way, and tens of thousands of creative and custom worlds have been made since then!

In December, our first Major Update “Fellhollow” arrived with the Farming skill, a new building kit, two new NPCs and a shop for trading Soul Fragments with Death himself. Material upgrades brought you the Castle kit to make a spooky stronghold. You can also earn and equip Steel tier gear, complete with its iconic plumed Full Helm, and then made RuneScape history by adding Mounts! Ride a terrorbird and traverse the treacherous terrain in style! The second Dragon boss, Imaru the Revenant Dragon has tested, and will continue to test, the strength of your soul and offers unique rewards for those who grant her finality and peace.
[img src="https://framerusercontent.com/images/WICbTehr0q1lflHrMx61etRt1wY.png" style="aspect-ratio: 1920 / 1080;"][/img]

We added more to Fellhollow with our minor updates, monthly content drops adding quests, rewards and new decorations – new repeatable content in the form of Spectral Platforming, Buried Treasures and Letters for the Dead, and quests in the form of “Things That Go Boom In The Night”, “Doric’s Quest”, “Letters for the Dead”, “What Remains is Written” and “Mirror, Mirror”.

In March, we launched our next Major Update, with 4 more quests for players to take on, a new boss to overcome in the legendary Black Knight Titan, and a new region – Dowdun Reach. We launched support for Dedicated Servers, improved controller support, and a ton of bug fixes, before the arrival of Fishing.
[img src="https://framerusercontent.com/images/H8ZOS9RD779fd3yFCfLETgcGw9w.png" style="aspect-ratio: 1920 / 1080;"][/img]

We added three new quests: “Cook’s Assistant”, “Animal Magnetism” and “A Room with a Garou” alongside the Fishing skill which let you catch pristine fish to make new wall-mounted decorative trophies of your finest catches, providing the best healing-per-stack of any food item. We added Auto-run, auto-magnetising nearby items in the world to reduce inputs picking up items around you, the option to hide your helmet to show off your beautiful face and stopped Chickens, Cows and Kebbits from automatically attacking the player unprovoked so you can enjoy your cozy abode or a chill walk around in peace.
[img src="https://framerusercontent.com/images/OccuPZdkqacJER4niXWnWhq39E.png" style="aspect-ratio: 1920 / 1080;"][/img]

We reworked health and healing to let you tick-eat food like the other RuneScape games for optimal survivability in combat. We removed Wardstone to make your health bar more clearly representing your survivability, but also adding Sanguine Urns around the world to increase your Max HP by 10, permanently, for each unique one you find and use.

Our latest and largest Major Update, Umbral Sands, introduced a new form of Mount – the flying carpet – and introduced you to a region inspired by the Kharidian Deserts of RuneScape. Within this region, we introduced the Kalphite Queen and her brood, Fuzan the Fire Dragon and the Kot’Haar, sentient golems of Obsidian, given life by an Elder Artefact. We also added the Nightmare Crucible, allowing you to earn upgrade materials to power up your favourite weapons from lower Power Levels to be max level to face Kuldra with the release of Scorned Wilderness.  The region allows users to craft Adamant Armour, Red Dragonhide and Infinity Robes as well as additional vestiges including Obsidian Armour, the Obsidian shield and the Fire Cape. We expanded the Skill Trees for Mining and Woodcutting, giving you new Skill Spells and passive rewards, and added more NPC traders for users to trade with.
[img src="https://framerusercontent.com/images/SKDl2hlRvRZIC3eGFpDbGUpG4.jpg" style="aspect-ratio: 3840 / 2160;"][/img]
What's New in 1.0?
New Content
Added support for Consoles! This includes PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, XBOX Series X | S and PC on Epic Games Store, Jagex Launcher and Steam.
Added Crossplay!
In the in-game menu, worlds can now be enabled as crossplay when you load them.
Crossplay worlds will be shown in the world browser.
Players now have the option to make their worlds crossplay or not each time they host a multiplayer world
Dedicated servers now also have crossplay option.
You can now join worlds through invite codes! Invite codes can be entered in the world browser screen, and are shown in the in game pause menu.

Killing Kuldra will ensure you get a drop - the Dragon Kiteshield, and then a Cape to wear with pride. In a slight deviation from previous iterations, this shield won't be a Dragonfire shield as you had in previous Dragon Generals.
There is also going to be a selection of pieces of the
iconic
Dragon armour - glorious, resplendent and
red,
including the
Dragon Scimitar
and the
Dragon Crossbow.
These are earned through repeat adventures into the Scorned Wilderness - provided you're successful again.
Added the Advanced Spinning Wheel
Once unlocked, this will be a new processing bench in the build menu, separate from the Spinning Wheel.
Items that can be processed in the regular Spinning Wheel cannot be used in the Advanced Spinning Wheel.
Here's all the new items you'll be collecting:
Runite Ore - requires Adamant Pickaxe or greater
Luminite Ore - requires Adamant Pickaxe or greater
Magic Wood - requires Rune Logging Axe or greater (the future is a mystery to us all, you know...)
Black Dragon Hide - crafted at the Advanced Tannery
Runic Powder - crafted at the Grindstone
Disordent Residue - dropped by enemies during the Raid.
Harmonised Compound - crafted in the kiln.
Ground Dragon Tooth - crafted at the Grindstone.
Vis Fibers - crafted at the Advanced Spinning Wheel
Draconic Vis Wax - crafted at the Brewing Cauldron.
Vis Cloth - crafted at the Loom using Vis Fibers and Draconic Vis Wax.
Magic Tree Seeds are coming with 1.0.1 to allow you to grow your own!
We've added a new magic weapon type... Wands!

Wands are a more mobile, fast-paced way to deal more damage at a comparatively lower damage output. These will still apply buildup of knockdowns, burns and slows that you expect from Air, Fire and Water magic. You'll be able to use wands to move more fluidly in combat and get around, but also hang back with a Staff and lay down more damage if you want!

Enchant Weapon: Water Skill Spell
. Enchant your current Melee weapon with the power of Water! Strike enemies with Water damage and occasionally create healing orbs to restore your health. 15x Water + 5x Astral Runes (300s Cooldown)

- increasing the duration of the Spell.

spells have had their durations increased to 5 minutes.

items: Hello adventurers! Firstly, we want to thank you for your enthusiasm, passion and support for our 1.0 release. It's been truly humbling and exhilarating seeing you all take on Kuldra, and we're already hard at work reviewing the data, assessing feedback and making plans. For now, though, we're pleased to be deploying a hotfix to tackle several issues.
We have applied a fix affecting World Saves becoming corrupted when exiting a game session!
Resolved an issue where casting a Fishing Rod at a player-made structure crashed the game.
Fixed an issue where adjusting some parts of the settings will cause a crash.

We're still investigating an additional issue reported where some users have found that worlds in their world list have gone missing/turned invisible. We're in active conversation with the platform teams from each console to better understand the situation, with the aim of helping players recover these worlds and have them reappear in a future patch. This will require additional testing to verify.
The process for deploying this patch does, however, mean that
Nintendo Switch 2 and Jagex Launcher
systems will
no longer be able to crossplay until the patch has been processed on their respective platforms
. We'll update in the comments when these have been processed and the platforms allow you to dive back into Crossplay!

body.text: Full notes

items: Hello adventurers!
We’re targeting this hotfix to go live on Friday.
We’re sharing the notes with you
today
so you’re aware of where we’re at, and we’ll be submitting it the consoles with the expectation that this verification
will take several days
This is based on your feedback around the updates knocking crossplay offline – we hear you, and we’re trying to avoid a weekend of disrupted gameplay for Nintendo Switch 2 players.
The big topic of conversation is: we’re investigating the fixes about Save Corruption – world and character. We’re testing methods that will,
hopefully
, restore your missing saves. We need longer to investigate these solutions and the potential recovery options.
We’re removing the
most common cause
, to mitigate impact for further people:
the Edit Appearance button is going to disappear until we’ve resolved the issue.

Restoring some saves has meant that the world has been reset to default settings – which means that Custom or Creative worlds will have been reverted to Normal worlds. These might be in your Normal save lists!
Here’s what we’re targeting a fix with 1.0.0.5 on Friday:
Users no longer fail to connect to Multiplayer servers with more than 2 players present
This also specifically resolves multiplayer clients on XBOX being unable to connect if 2 users are already in the world.
AI will now respawn as intended on starting the second Scorned Wilderness Raid attempt.
Fixing an issue where joining a modded Dedicated Server from consoles would corrupt a player save.
Primordial Hearts, Imbued Granite Maul Heads and Chinchompa Skulls can now all be destroyed or stored.
Dying in the Scorned Wilderness Raid will no longer skip a respawn point.
The Abyssal Whip Recipe now unlocks for users with existing character saves as intended.
Resolved an issue where Sworn Servant could not be cast in Multiplayer/Dedicated Servers.
Hud Scale options are now correctly labelled on Steam.
Players with Privacy and Safety Settings on XBOX will be notified when a conflicting privacy setting prevents them from going online.
On controller, Processing Stations will now highlight the button where the players cursor is located.
Resolving an issue where Dedicated Server owners could not edit their dedicated server worlds on consoles.
The Server search bar has an added tooltip to specify that it is Case Sensitive.
The Switch 2 Video Capture is now working as intended.
Resolving a bug where PS5 users could trigger a crash when creating a crossplay world with a password in certain instances.
“Self-hosted Server” button in Steam will now navigate the player to the hosting Tools.
Luminite ore can now be crafted into Divine Rocks.
DLSS and FSR upscaling are now available in the Video Settings for Windows/XBOX Game Pass versions.
Summon Shelter will be able to be used in the Scorned Wilderness hub.
On our radar:
We’re aware of an issue where if you disconnect from your internet/wifi and try and select Play Online, the game will instead crash. Targeting a fix in 1.0.1 for this!
We’ve got a few keybinds that can be currently re-bound that aren’t intended to be remapped. We’ll be resetting these to default binds with the 1.0.1 update too!

Thank you for your continued patience, support and feedback. We’re very excited to keep polishing, refining and growing RuneScape: Dragonwilds for years to come. Next weekend, at RuneFest, we’ll be showing our roadmap in more detail and we’re looking forward to sharing more about 1.0.1, October’s update, very soon too.

items: Here's what's on our radar in regards to known issues.
We're looking to deploy a hotfix as soon as possible to address the following:

Users are unable to skip the "Corrupted Save" warning popup on the main menu on controller in some circumstances. Some users have reported that repeatedly hitting "accept"/"A"/"X" on controller or disconnecting and reconnecting the controller skips this, but we're working on a holistic fix.
Ranged Special Attacks are causing crashes on Dedicated Servers in some instances when hitting some targets.
Here's what we're aware of beyond tomorrow's hotfix - we'll get these resolved as soon as possible.
Air Magic Staff Attack Combo's 4th does not currently deal damage on-hit.
The other Air Stave attacks work as intended as do Wands - there are also the other elemental types and melee and ranged, of course, but we know you want to live our your Mage fantasy. We've got you.
Wearing an Amulet or Ring that degrades over time resets the Runecrafting UI's Essence counter to 1 with every tick.

Splitting stacks in chests, on controller, is causing the UI to freeze. Some users are reporting that you can back out of the freeze with RS / R3 / Sorting the chest, but we're working on a holistic fix.
Fixes for skips in the Scorned Wilderness Raid.
Fix for an menu navigation error when PS5 users sign out of their account while accepting an invite.
A fix for XBOX Series X hosted worlds where only one user can join at a time.
Fix for inventory not persisting when switching worlds.
Mucksplosion is not correctly affecting the 3x3 radius it shows before casting.
An issue where some Corrupted World Saves are disappearing for players.
Fix for users experiencing a failed download initiation on Jagex Launcher.

body.text: Full notes

items: Save Fixes

The big headline for this one is a range of fixes targeting the disappearing world saves we've seen reported, as well as a catch-up mechanic for corrupted character saves that will let you drop in with aggregated stats and Tier 4 gear to get you back in the fight. Hop in and give those a try, but we're aware there may still be the occasional player affected by other, extraneous instances of save issues that we're still collecting data on. We're talking about very, very small numbers of affected players, but it matters all the same. Beyond that, let's get into what else is coming in 1.0.1.
1.0.1 and Core Improvements
What goes up...
Introducing... the Jump Attack. It does exactly what you think it does.
Unlock the Skill Tree perk "Death From Above!"
Any time you are
slightly

above the max height of the double jump's arc from the ground, inputting an attack will plunge you downward to slam into unfortunate victims below. Damage scales with the weapon you have equipped, so make sure you're holding something hefty before you leap. And yes, Windstep counts here. What goes up, must come crashing down.
I've Got Shooters
Added the Ranged skill perk - Ammo Recovery, and it's Greater version later in the Skill Tree - Greater Ammo Recovery.
Adds a chance to recover arrows from the bodies of slain enemies.
Ranged weapon subclasses are receiving their own special attack variants to make them feel more aligned with the fantasy of using the Shortbow, Longbow or Crossbow.
Shortbow: Rapid Fire - Hop backwards and fire off three arrows in quick succession. The target can be switched between this volley of shots to spread the damage.
Longbow: Power Shot - take a knee to draw an arrow at full strength. Let fly to loose a staggering, enormously powerful shot at great distance.
Crossbow: Heavy Bolt - rack a bolt and let it fly after a short charge. Hits like Asgarnian Ale on an empty stomach, and applies Enchanted effects on-hit.

Introduced the Low Blow Skill Perk: Ranged attacks that hit the enemy in the legs (lower third of the body or their legs) applies "Hamstrung" which reduces enemy movement speed for a short while. Tiny and Colossal Enemies are immune.
...And The Rest
Increased inventory space from 32 to 40.
Added a toggle for the Visceral Attack Camera change.
[img src="][/img]
Fixed an issue where users on mounts could not open the map correctly.
Obstacles and Enemies now respawn in the Scorned Wildnerness Raid on reset/next run-through.
Reduced aggro range for enemies across the game to prevent forming a bit of a follow-train like a Fally Drop Party.
Enemy mob respawn timers extended so they stay dead for longer as you clear areas.
Fixed an issue where users on controller were unable to sort chests with L3/LS correctly.
Polish pass on Mining nodes across the world to ensure they're all above ground and can be mined.
Goblin "barks" (ambient noises they make) should now sound less like they've just seen you and are yelling.
Improvements on the Sort functionality - Weight, Type and Latest.
Weight: Cumulative Stack Weight, Heaviest First.
Type: Categories of item, alphabetically.
Latest: The most recently picked up items first.
Adding a dedicated Ring AND Amulet slot.
Thanks to Thurnax, NeganTWD, Cloud_N0ne and others who suggested this.
The Amulet of Glory was providing additional bonuses above what was initially intended, so we're tapping those numbers back down to better align with what we wanted it to be.
We're adding the Ultra Compost Bin - because "Super" just wasn't cutting it anymore.
Adding the Large Compost Bucket, which has a larger capacity.
Now stop asking.
Adding a Completed Quests tab including a short summary of the outcome of the quest.
[img src="][/img]
Overdrive can now be cast on the Advanced Spinning Wheel.
Rune Arrows and Bolts now do more damage than Adamant. 4.9x versus 4.2x.
The Fishing Cape now correctly displays the Skillcape Perk - You have a small chance to instantly catch a fish.
Removed the ability to rebind keybinds for settings that could soft lock the player in certain instances:
Interaction
Remove Spell
Building
Cancel Building
Quick Interact
Crafting
Crafting Tab Left/Right
Quest Dialogue
Continue Conversation
Cancel Conversation
Select Answer 1/2/3/4
Additional Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where users could clip through the floor when teleporting to Cataclysm Keep from Commander Zilyana.
Resolved an issue where PS5 users were unable to see the assigned Sort button on chests.

Resolved an issue where Players who had acquired Quest Items early (through multiplayer sessions) would be unable to progress to the next region. E.g. Imaru's Head prevented the player from entering Fellhollow, etc.
Resolved an issue where users could crash when selecting Online play while being Offline.
Fixed an issue where Rain would cause visual effects to be visible inside player housing at any graphical setting. It no longer rains indoors!
Resolved an issue where Sanguine Urns within the radius of the Scorned Wilderness were not displaying correctly.
Resolved an issue where the Skills Page description states Magic Focus can be crafted at the Crafting Table instead of the Blacksmith's Bench.
Fixed an issue where images in the Journal could scale incorrectly. Begone, giant Bandos symbol!
Fixed an issue where Hosts would unlock achivements triggered by a player in the world.
Resolved a bug causing Ascension Cores to not drop from Kuldra in some circumstances.
Fixed an issue where users with Emojis in their name on PC would not be able to join PS5 or XBOX player hosted worlds.
Fixed the Dragon Med Helm icon to be the right shade of red. So, so sorry.
All platforms can now access the UI Scaling option as intended.
Special Attacks from Ranged will now trigger gamepad vibration as intended.
Fixed an issue where Maple Sap would not be removed from the inventory on death. Sticky stuff.
Resolved an issue where the VFX on the title screen was offset incorrectly.
Fixed an issue where D-pad Navigation in the Chest Inventory UI would not work in certain circumstances.
Fixed an issue where Map Fog would not be cleared when entering a new area after being on an Agility Course.
Resolved an issue where HP would fail to regen at the stated rate in certain circumstances.
Fixed an issue where users were unable to navigate the Skills menu via mouse clicks the first time in a session.
Resolved an issue where users could hear Kuldra from the Saradomin Temple, if another player was in the raid. She's loud, but not that loud... right?
Fixed an issue where Reward Chests would play default open SFX.
Fixed a bug where Titan's Wrath would set the player on fire if the Special Attack was used in rapid succession.
Fixed a bug where Fuzan would become passive if a player died in certain circumstances, essentially becoming invisible.
Fixed incomplete Waterfall VFX in the Fractured Plains.
Fixed an issue where the Inventory being open would not show tooltips on XBOX or PC.
Fixed inconsistent Cursor Navigation within the Building UI.
Fixed an issue where users on Dedicated Servers could not place Foundation or floor pieces if one had been previously destroyed there.
Fixed an issue where the Gilded Gyrhawk Amulet would not unlock upon completion of all gold times.
Fixed an issue where Keyboards would freeze after any form of teleport - Vault entry or exit, Lodestone or Kebbit Burrow.
Resolved an Epic Games Store issue where users would not be able to view Dedicated Servers - even if they had connected to them previously.
Fixed an issue where Emote and Spellwheel would briefly flash up when opening the spellbook.
Fixed a short freeze when unmounting for the first time after launch.
Fixed the Regicide achievement which would not unlock after killing Kuldra under certain circumstances.
Fix for Scorch and Wither HUD icons being misaligned, and Scorch displaying 999 after restarting the game with it maxed.
Fix for audio not triggering Combat music in Dowdun Reach when fighting "normal" enemies.
Fixed an issue where the Terrorbird's death audio would play too late.
Resolved an issue where Jagex Launcher users could claim multiple beds.
Fixed a spot in Emberwood in Fellhollow where players could get stuck between two rocks and fall indefinitely.
Resolved an issue where freshly used Kebbit Burrow holes would appear uncleared.
Resolved an issue where when opening the Map, the "Map Open" SFX would get cut off before playing in full, and then would not play on subsequent opens.
Resolved an issue where players would not be able to open the build menu while the building information pop up was still visible.
Resolved an issue where the Enfeeble spell would not effectively reduce damage across all enemy types.
Resolved an issue where becoming withered in Fellhollow would cause foliage to move very quickly.
Fixed an issue where placing the Personal Chest item around specific items would cause a large game hitch/freeze.
Fixed an issue where Wither Curse would apply in inaccurate locations within Hope's Fall.
Fixed an issue where the Scorned Wilderness, Dowdun Reach and Umbral Sands journal entries in Journal > Knowledge > Places weren't showing.
Fixed an issue where users on a Dedicated Server would not register properly if another client had been reset by position or death.
Fixed an issue where the Divine Rock cooldown is incorrectly set to 1500 seconds instead of 1800 seconds.
Fixed an issue where Superheat would display placeholder text when used without a valid target.
Fixed an issue where Water Magic Wand projectiles would not be visible on multiplayer worlds unless very close.
Fixed an issue where Air magic attacks visually travel further than their effective range.
Fixed an issue where the Dowdun Reach Nexus would have flickering VFX when viewed from outside.
Fixed an issue where Clients on older worlds see the Sanguine Urn in Fenkenstrain's Castle in a different place and may not be able to interact with it.
Resolved an issue where attempting to use multiple consumable items simultaneously would trigger a constant item cooldown overlay on the item toolbar.
Fixed the Rune Spade so it isn't upside-down in the weapons rack. Ah, that's better.
Fixed an issue where the Zogre lock-on point was too high on the model so the camera was unwieldy in melee range.
Fixed an issue where the Artisan and Construction Cape's effects were not triggering on use - repairing and building, respectively.
Kebbit Burrows should now be correctly labelled.
Fixed an issue where Green Dragons could get caught on the edge of the Alcarrid Oasis instanced area.
Overall polish pass on Green Dragons after reports of stuttering/clipping at certain angles.
Resolved an issue where the Kuldra (ahem) Interior section would prevent users from using Camera Lock On on targets within.
Resolved an issue where In Alcarrid's camp, reputation was not gradually progressing but rather would jump to level 4 once all quests were completed.
Resolved an issue where sorting Servers would return inconsistent results.

items: Hello adventurers! Here's what's in our latest patch.
Dedicated Servers will need to be restarted to apply the hotfix.
Fix for the Air Magic Staff Attack Combo's 4th hit not dealing damage or applying on-hit effects.
Splitting stacks with a controller when the item in the chest no longer causes a hitch where the controller becomes unresponsive.
Fix for Runecrafting values being defaulted to 1/50 whenever an amulet or ring degraded or lost durability.
Fix for XBOX Series X hosted worlds not being able to support more than one XBOX Client joining the world at a time.
Additional fixes for Kuldra Skips.
Resolved an issue where users would lose progress when players with the same display name would try (and fail) to log in.
Fixed an issue where the Dragon Scimitar would not allow users to Jump Attack in certain circumstances.
Fix for "Silent" quests where the Quest UI would show them incorrectly, including calling missing objective text.
Fix for Linux-based Dedicated Servers crashing when teleporting.

Thanks for your patience with us on this one. We'll be in touch very soon with the latest updates on all things 1.0.2 and what's to come next month! Until then, be good, and we'll see you in Ashenfall.
