body.text: On speedrun.com

**Run Notes:**

• It might be possible to get to the first wooden bridge with a good enough Zoop from the Air Anima Pillar... (After it's activated to remove the wall, of course) (~0:35 - 0:43) 

• With an insane Zoop from vines it's possible to land on the wall with the vine breaking through instead of having to run and Windjump on to it, but I've only done it once. (~1:24 - 1:38) 

• Likewise you can make it all the way to the door just past the plant with a good enough Zoop from the wall with mobs on it. (~1:41 - 1:45) 

• You can get a much better Zoop from the vine to bridge that doesn't require any dashes. (~2:13 - 2:18) 

• You can (again) get a much better Zoop from Stronghold to Keep that doesn't require any dashes. (~3:15 - 3:19) 

• Got stuck here for a second lmao. Don't do that. (~3:26) 

• Lost about a second to bonking (~3:44) and accidentally tapping shift cancelling my sprint. (~4:04) 

• The Windjump can make it all the way to the second rock (~4:35 - 4:40) instead of having to double-jump up. 

• The Rib Clip can be done much faster, if you're lucky with the Windjump and your placement, it can immediately clip you through without having to crouch/swing sword. (~5:08) 

• I'm not sure if it's better to save the surge leftover at this point and use it like I did (crossing to Kuldra), or use it earlier before Windjumping up. I'd have to recast it at the top but it could still be faster, and save me a surge from the second side of Kuldra's bridge to her face (instead of jump/dashing), as well as one for the throat. 

• The melee safespot inside the heart could probably be entered faster. 

• Overall just doing things more cleanly will produce a sub 7 considering my sum of best is 6:58.
body.author: Nanobit (run comment)

body.text:
very cool jump at 2:30, cool route from elemental puzzle -> rib cage that was cool i've only done earlier versions



I think the cd on surge might still be rolling as you're running up to kuldra's gate but I could see refreshing saving a few seconds. I haven't practiced this run much but are there any ways to cut the corner left at the beginning of sanctum?

body.text:
That's what i meant by using it earlier yeah, if you see pete's run you can save a bit of time cutting before windjumping up the fragments in sanctum, at the time i was thinking it would be faster without recasting, but we'll see as the run evolves.

ETA:
I should clarify the timestamps in the run notes are from the run time, not the video time, sorry about that.

body.text: How

items: Pass the water door into the stronghold.
Kill the air-anima Garou Thane through the closed gate with a melee weapon.
Air-charged, windjump from the tip of the rubble pile up to the air door and go through.
Exit through the hole in the wall above the orb dispenser.
The Thane takes ~15 min to respawn — sleep through a night between attempts.

body.text: Mentioned in transcripts, chat and comments (10)

• The Zoop from Stronghold to Keep could have been stronger (I've made it with 0 Air/Phase Dash before), as well as the one to Kuldra (same story). I suspect the strength of the zoop is dependent on framerate where lower framerates give stronger zoops.

• The OOB Section can have cleaner Windsteps, skipping 2 Double Jumps.

• Need to test if clipping back through the ground at Kuldra is faster than respawning.
body.author: Nanobit (run comment)

body.text:
**Run Notes:**

• It might be possible to get to the first wooden bridge with a good enough Zoop from the Air Anima Pillar... (After it's activated to remove the wall, of course) (~0:35 - 0:43) 

• With an insane Zoop from vines it's possible to land on the wall with the vine breaking through instead of having to run and Windjump on to it, but I've only done it once. (~1:24 - 1:38) 

• Likewise you can make it all the way to the door just past the plant with a good enough Zoop from the wall with mobs on it. (~1:41 - 1:45) 

• You can get a much better Zoop from the vine to bridge that doesn't require any dashes. (~2:13 - 2:18) 

• You can (again) get a much better Zoop from Stronghold to Keep that doesn't require any dashes. (~3:15 - 3:19) 

• Got stuck here for a second lmao. Don't do that. (~3:26) 

• Lost about a second to bonking (~3:44) and accidentally tapping shift cancelling my sprint. (~4:04) 

• The Windjump can make it all the way to the second rock (~4:35 - 4:40) instead of having to double-jump up. 

• The Rib Clip can be done much faster, if you're lucky with the Windjump and your placement, it can immediately clip you through without having to crouch/swing sword. (~5:08) 

• I'm not sure if it's better to save the surge leftover at this point and use it like I did (crossing to Kuldra), or use it earlier before Windjumping up. I'd have to recast it at the top but it could still be faster, and save me a surge from the second side of Kuldra's bridge to her face (instead of jump/dashing), as well as one for the throat. 

• The melee safespot inside the heart could probably be entered faster. 

• Overall just doing things more cleanly will produce a sub 7 considering my sum of best is 6:58.

body.text: Mentioned in transcripts, chat and comments (23)

**Run Notes:**

• It might be possible to get to the first wooden bridge with a good enough Zoop from the Air Anima Pillar... (After it's activated to remove the wall, of course) (~0:35 - 0:43) 

• With an insane Zoop from vines it's possible to land on the wall with the vine breaking through instead of having to run and Windjump on to it, but I've only done it once. (~1:24 - 1:38) 

• Likewise you can make it all the way to the door just past the plant with a good enough Zoop from the wall with mobs on it. (~1:41 - 1:45) 

• You can get a much better Zoop from the vine to bridge that doesn't require any dashes. (~2:13 - 2:18) 

• You can (again) get a much better Zoop from Stronghold to Keep that doesn't require any dashes. (~3:15 - 3:19) 

• Got stuck here for a second lmao. Don't do that. (~3:26) 

• Lost about a second to bonking (~3:44) and accidentally tapping shift cancelling my sprint. (~4:04) 

• The Windjump can make it all the way to the second rock (~4:35 - 4:40) instead of having to double-jump up. 

• The Rib Clip can be done much faster, if you're lucky with the Windjump and your placement, it can immediately clip you through without having to crouch/swing sword. (~5:08) 

• I'm not sure if it's better to save the surge leftover at this point and use it like I did (crossing to Kuldra), or use it earlier before Windjumping up. I'd have to recast it at the top but it could still be faster, and save me a surge from the second side of Kuldra's bridge to her face (instead of jump/dashing), as well as one for the throat. 

• The melee safespot inside the heart could probably be entered faster. 

• Overall just doing things more cleanly will produce a sub 7 considering my sum of best is 6:58.

If you have tried this, you know there is so many places that one small mistake will blow the run. Very happy to pull this near perfect run out. There is room for improvement but it will take many attempts to replicate. 

We will see how it evolves if some new strats come into play. Cheers

pages.title: Abyssal Demon
pages.summary: A teleporting demon mini-boss in Fragments of Ghornfell that the route runs past. Since 0.10 it teleports to you if you get too far away or out of reach.

props.Behaviour: Teleports, then attacks in quick succession
props.Leash: Teleports to the player if too far away or in an inaccessible area (0.10)

body.text: For speedrunning

items: The quick guide says "run past or fight". Its teleport-to-player leash means it can follow you briefly. Keep moving uphill.
Route notes in this repo reference a Surge/Phase Dash past the demon (s-demon).

pages.title: Agility (skill)
pages.summary: Agility was added in 0.12.1 (29 July 2026). It unlocks the whole movement kit: Windstep, Double Jump, Air Dash, Phase Dash and Recall, plus passive perks that cut stamina costs.

props.Passive: Sprint stamina cost -0.085% per level (8.415% at 99)

body.title: All facts
rows: Sprint stamina cost -0.085% per level (8.415% at 99)
Small chance to avoid stamina use when jumping, dashing or evading
Foot travel, courses, dodging vault traps, dodging enemy attacks

body.text: For speedrunning

items: Every raid skip in the current route needs some of these unlocks. Level the character before attempting runs.
The 0.12.1 patch notes say Agility was built "to make you faster, leaner and meaner"; jumping cost dropped from 20 to 10 stamina in the same patch.

body.text: Patch history

items: 0.12.1 — Agility skill added; Windstep moved from Runecrafting to Agility; jump cost 20 -> 10 stamina.

pages.title: Black Dragon
pages.summary: A power level 8 dragon with 6,000 HP that is immune to fire. Three spawn in the raid, and the route runs past them.

props.Spawns: Dragontail Vines, Fragments of Ghornfell, The Shattered Stronghold
props.Attacks: Lunge, tail sweep (behind), fire claw, poison blast, fire breath, wing attack, fly + line breath that can lock you in

body.text: For speedrunning

items: Skipped in every route. The quick guide says "run past or fight".
The airborne line-breath staggers you and can lock you in for all of its damage. Do not cross its line.
Nanobit: after the zoop from Keep, a strong enough zoop near the 3rd Black Dragon carries you well past the plant.

pages.title: Breakfall
pages.summary: An Agility 35 passive that makes you roll out of high falls automatically, taking less landing damage. Fatal falls still kill.

props.Effect: Automatic roll on high falls reduces landing damage

body.text: For speedrunning

items: The 0.12.1 notes warn: "Fatal falls will still kill you though." Breakfall does not replace Windstep slow-fall or Reactive Recall on big drops.

pages.title: Cataclysm Keep
pages.summary: The fourth segment: a Dragonkin vault-style keep with valve platforms, four pylons and a pressure-pad puzzle (Air, Water, Earth, Fire) that opens the way to the final teleporter.

props.Puzzle order: Air, Water, Earth, Fire pressure pads (step on all to reset)
props.Valves: Water pylon valve must route power to the pads; second valve stops the platforms
props.Enemies: Vault Guardian Hulks and Sentinel (dormant), Black Dragon, Wild Jade Vines, Garou Hunter

body.text: For speedrunning

items: TexasPete ran a sub-9 while "completing the Cataclysm Keep puzzle" before learning the skip. Current runs skip the puzzle.
Nanobit credits notmusty1 (via IINo1goodII) with "a lovely hole in Keep". Runners also describe an OOB (out-of-bounds) section.

body.text: Mentioned in transcripts, chat and comments (18)

This run is a mix of some of my original strats and some borrowed. I was able to pull off a sub 9 run while staying in the map and completing the Cataclysm Keep puzzle before I saw some videos of the skip recently. 

I accidently stopped the clock less than a second short. Total time was roughly 7.40.84

If you have tried this, you know there is so many places that one small mistake will blow the run. Very happy to pull this near perfect run out. There is room for improvement but it will take many attempts to replicate. 

We will see how it evolves if some new strats come into play. Cheers

pages.title: Checkpoints, Zilyana Teleporters and extraction points
pages.summary: Each segment ends at a Zilyana Teleporter. Reaching one shows "Extraction Point Reached" and keeps your progress if you go back to Rasthin's Rest. Finishing a run resets all progress.

props.Activation: Come within range; banner "Extraction Point Reached"
props.Progress: Kept between trips to Rasthin's Rest within a run
props.After Kuldra: Progress resets; Zilyana can only send you to Dragontail Vines
props.Count: One after each of the four segments (quick guide)
props.Death: Respawn at bed; gravestone near Zilyana

body.text: For speedrunning

items: The community split file splits on the extraction-point banner for segments 1-4.
Before 1.0.0.5, dying could skip a respawn point. That was fixed.
The wiki has no "Extraction point" page; the facts come from the Zilyana Teleporter page.

pages.title: Crystallised Anima
pages.summary: Raid scenery you touch to attune to an element for 30 seconds. Attunement opens elemental gates, charges pylons and buys orbs.

props.Uses: Pass an elemental gate; charge an Anima Pylon; request an orb from an Anima Orb Dispenser
props.Alternate sources: Killing elemental-attuned mobs or Kuldra's hatchlings grants their element

body.text: For speedrunning

items: The 30 s window is the clock for every gate sequence. Routes are timed so you attune, then gate, without wasting time.
This repo's split file uses Crystallized Anima pickups as fallback split markers when no LiveSplit panel is on screen.

pages.title: Dodge / Evade
pages.summary: Dodging costs 20 stamina. Since 1.0, dodging or blocking cancels attacks, gathering and spell casting. The Evasion perk cuts dodge cost by 33%.

props.Evasion perk: -33% dodge cost for 300 or 600 s (Evasive / Cooling evasive infusion)
props.Cancels: Dodge or block cancels attacks, gathering and spell-casting (1.0)
props.Agility XP: Dodging enemy attacks and vault traps grants Agility XP

body.text: For speedrunning

items: Since 1.0, a dodge ends any recovery animation early. Dodge out of a cast or swing once its effect has started.
The wiki has no Dodge page; the "Dodge" link redirects to the Evasion perk.

pages.title: Dragontail Vines
pages.summary: The first raid segment. Charge an air pylon, shelter under Zilyana's dome while Kuldra passes, then work through air, earth and water gates to the first teleporter.

props.Intended route: Attune air -> charge Pylon 1 -> shelter in Zilyana dome -> air gate -> earth gate -> water Pylon 2 (kill air skeleton, orb from dispenser, lever, charge)
props.Enemies: Black Dragon, Zombies, Skeletal Archers, Skeletal Warriors (elemental variants)
props.Resources: Runite ore, Luminite ore, Magic trees

body.text: For speedrunning

items: Run notes describe zoops from the Air Anima pillar toward the first wooden bridge, and from vines onto the wall where the vine breaks through.

pages.title: Fleet-footed Infusion
pages.summary: A cheap drink that grants Fleet Footed: sprinting costs 50% less stamina for 300 seconds.

props.Effect: Fleet Footed perk: -50% sprint stamina cost
props.Recipe: 1 Clean Water + 1 Feathers at a Stone or Cooking Range

body.text: For speedrunning

items: With base sprint at 4 stamina/s, a 50% cut roughly doubles sprint time. 300 s covers most of a sub-7 raid run.
Infusions do not stack with each other (Kuldra strategy page). Choose between this and Pumpkin Spice.
The Stamina page still lists Fleet Footed as -20%. The perk and infusion pages say 50% since 0.11. Trust the patch-history value.

pages.title: Jump Attack (Death From Above!)
pages.summary: An Attack perk that lets you make an area-of-effect melee attack while airborne, from roughly 5 metres up or at the peak of a Windstep jump.

props.Height: At least 5 metres, or at the peak of a Windstep jump
props.Damage: Scales with the equipped weapon; no multiplier published
props.Released: Wiki says 1.0 (15 Sep 2026); the 1.0.1 notes introduce it as new. Disputed

body.text: For speedrunning

items: The 1.0.1 notes say it triggers "any time you are slightly above the max height of the double jump's arc" and "Windstep counts here".
Nanobit credits "plunge-cancel tech" in his 7:01 run. The name suggests cancelling the jump-attack (plunge) animation, but no source explains how it works.

pages.title: Kuldra, the God-Eater
pages.summary: A five-headed, power level 9 dragon queen. You cannot damage her directly: over three phases you hit her with the Anima Cannon six times each, then go inside her to kill her heart.

props.Phases 1-3: 6 Anima Cannon hits each (two orb deposits = 6 blasts in phase 1)
props.Phase 4: Enter the main head's mouth; kill Kuldra's Heart
props.Heads: Green poison, red fireballs (5; 7 in P2), white ice shard, blue lightning
props.Hatchlings: One per phase 1-3; killing one grants its element
props.Transition: Stay in Zilyana's barrier or take rapid damage
props.Needs: Anti-dragon shield or Super Antifire; antipoison

pages.title: Kuldra's Heart
pages.summary: The Phase 4 target inside Kuldra. It stays in the middle of the chamber, sets off poison explosions that hit harder as its HP drops, and is guarded by respawning Heartworms.

props.Hazards: Poison AoE explosions scaling with lost HP; Heartworms
props.Safe spot: Entrance tunnel (ranged/magic): avoids most explosions, few worm spawns
props.After kill: Run to the exit ("Get out now!" timer); timer length not documented

body.text: For speedrunning

items: The run timer stops when the screen goes black after the "Get out now!" timer, so the escape is part of the run.
Nanobit says the melee safespot inside the heart "could probably be entered faster".
Antipoison is required. The strategy page suggests a 300 s Antipoison.

pages.title: Leggings of Lightness
pages.summary: Power level 1 legs that add 50 carry weight. Since 1.0 they also make Windstep cost zero runes.

props.Effect: Windstep costs 0 runes while equipped; +50 carry weight
props.Recipe: 6 Coarse Animal Fur + 6 Rune Essence at a Crafting Table

items: With these equipped, the run does not need Air runes for Windstep, which is cast many times per run. The trade-off is zero leg armour.
The wiki intro still says they reduce fall damage. The 1.0 changelog removed Feather Fall, so that line is likely outdated.

pages.title: Parry
pages.summary: Block at the last moment to cancel the hit and stagger the attacker for roughly 3 seconds. Since 1.0 a parry also restores half your stamina.

props.Stagger: About 3 s (varies by enemy; bosses such as Velgar are exceptions)
props.Recovery: 0.550 s minimum before you can attack again

body.text: For speedrunning

items: A parry refills stamina without waiting for regen. Useful when a sprint is interrupted by a raid mob.
Garou Thanes block everything until their stance breaks. Parry and crush damage are the intended answers, but skipping them is faster.

body.text: Game rules (speedrun.com, live copy)
**In addition to any Game and Category Rules, all Runescape: Dragonwilds runs are subject to all Speedrun.com Site Rules, found [here](https://www.speedrun.com/support/learn/site-rules).**
**Video Requirements:**

items: All submissions requires a full video of the run, including game audio.
Game audio must be audible.
The video link MUST embed on the run page (e.g. no URL shorteners or sketchy file sharing sites)
VODs should persist indefinitely (e.g. Highlight instead of Past Broadcast)
Dynamic HUD elements should not be obscured or omitted (e.g. health, inventory, stamina)

body.text: **Good Faith Submissions**

Runs are expected to be performed in good faith and may be rejected based on mod discretion if performed otherwise. Examples include, but are not limited to: extended stalling to achieve a specific time; intentionally attempting to get the last place time on the leaderboard and/or the longest time possible; or attempting to exploit technicalities in the written category rules in a manner contrary to the spirit of the category. This means that long runs and/or runs with breaks will be considered in good faith so long as effort is still being made.
Category: Dragon Slayer
Must have a full, unedited video of the run. Audio is required.
Timer initially starts at first input. (Looking around with the camera before the timer starts is allowed)
Timer ends when the Primary Quest, "Dragon Slayer" is complete. This is done by summoning and defeating Velgar and bringing Velgar's head to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead village.
Category: Secondary Quests
Must have a full, unedited video of the run. Audio is required.
Must show character/world creation.
For multiplayer speedruns, all players perspectives must be fully recorded individually.
Timer initially starts at first input. (Looking around with the camera before the timer starts is allowed)
Timer ends when the specific secondary quest is complete.
Category: Any%
Must have a full, unedited video of the run. Audio is required.
Must show character/world creation.
Timer initially starts at first input. (Looking around with the camera before the timer starts is allowed)
Timer ends when the Primary Quest, "Dragon Slayer" is complete. This is done by summoning and defeating Velgar and bringing Velgar's head to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead village.
Category: Multiplayer
Must have a full, unedited video of the run. Audio is required.
Must show character/world creation.
For multiplayer speedruns, all players perspectives must be fully recorded individually.
Timer initially starts at first input. (Looking around with the camera before the timer starts is allowed)
Timer ends when the Primary Quest, "Dragon Slayer" is complete. This is done by summoning and defeating Velgar and bringing Velgar's head to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead village.
Category: Agility Course
**Agility Course Speedrunning**
**Any% Rules**
All tricks and glitches allowed. (Building preparation, auto run start, clipping through objects, ect.)
**Glitchless Rules**
The categories in this ruleset are meant to be played like an optimized casual playthrough.
Using potions, food/water, and spells is **ALLOWED.**
The following glitches and techniques are **NOT ALLOWED** in Glitchless Agility course speedruns.

items: Clipping
Auto Run Start (Must start standing still)
Creating any persistent, solid, player-generated object. (Constructions, totems, etc.)

body.text: Moderators may deny a run that uses any glitches and techniques not listed above at their discretion, and amend the ruleset to include such glitches/techniques.
Category: Raid
**Raid Speedrun Timing**
Timer starts the first frame the loading icon disappears going into the raid.
Timer ends on the frame the screen goes black after the "Get out now!" timer ends after defeating Kuldra's Heart.

pages.title: Rest
pages.summary: A sleep meter that caps max stamina when low. You cannot rest during combat or inside a raid, so restore it with tea or arrive rested.

props.Dwindle: 1 point / 72 s from 100 to 26; 1 / 144 s from 25 to 0
props.Nap: +1 per second (0 -> 100 in at most 100 s)
props.Night sleep: Full refill; clears Bleed, Poison, Shocked, Burning, Soulscourge
props.Fresh Start: 180 s buff after a full night: rest, hydration and sustenance stop dwindling
props.Raid: "Resting cannot be performed during combat or a raid"

body.text: For speedrunning

items: Sleep at Rasthin's Rest right before a run so Fresh Start (180 s) covers the opening segments.
A 7-minute run loses about 6 rest points to dwindling, so starting at 100 avoids Tired (50) easily. Deaths cost 15 each.
1.0.0.5 made Summon Shelter usable in the Scorned Wilderness hub.

pages.title: Scorned Wilderness
pages.summary: The game's first raid, released with 1.0 on 15 September 2026. It is a chain of floating islands ending at Kuldra. Each segment is unlocked by attuning to elements at Crystallised Anima and charging pylons.

props.Requirement: Complete Icthlarin's Little Helper; start Regicide
props.Zones: Rasthin's Rest -> Dragontail Vines -> Fragments of Ghornfell -> The Shattered Stronghold -> Cataclysm Keep -> Kuldra's Sanctum
props.Gear tier: Discordant Residue from raid mobs crafts power level 8 gear

body.text: For speedrunning

items: Category rule (speedrun.com Raid): timer starts on the first frame the loading icon disappears going into the raid and ends when the screen goes black after the "Get out now!" timer, after Kuldra's Heart dies.
Board is split into "1.0.0.6+" and "Pre 1.0.0.6" version ranges.
1.0.1 made obstacles and enemies respawn on reset or next run-through, so every attempt is a fresh instance.
1.0.1.2 added "Additional fixes for Kuldra Skips". Which skips were removed is not documented.

body.text: Patch history

items: [[patch:1.0.0.5|1.0.0.5]] — AI respawns on the second attempt; dying no longer skips a respawn point; Summon Shelter allowed in hub.
[[patch:1.0.1|1.0.1]] — Obstacles and enemies respawn on reset; instant ore respawn on teleport fixed; several Windstep skips fixed; clipping through floor when teleporting to Cataclysm Keep fixed.
[[patch:1.0.1.2|1.0.1.2]] — Additional fixes for Kuldra Skips.

body.text: Raid requirement

items: [[req:req-quest|Icthlarin's Little Helper → Regicide started]] — gates the raid entrance (NW Fractured Plains)

pages.title: Soulscourge
pages.summary: A status effect that triggers when the Toxicity bar fills, mainly from dirty water or burnt food. It deals 50 damage over 5 seconds.

props.Trigger: 6 dirty waters from empty, or more than 6 burnt food
props.Cleared by: Night sleep (Rest page); buildup also fades naturally

body.text: For speedrunning

items: Bring clean water only. A Soulscourge tick mid-run is pure lost HP, and you cannot sleep it off inside the raid.

pages.title: Stamina
pages.summary: A 100-point pool spent on sprinting, jumping, dodging and attacks. It regenerates after 3 seconds of rest, faster at higher hydration.

props.Regen delay: 3 s after the last stamina action
props.Shield block: 17 per successful block; holding is free

body.title: All facts
rows: 3 s after the last stamina action
17 per successful block; holding is free
Fleet Footed -20% sprint (stamina page; perk page says 50%); Evasion -33% dodge

body.text: For speedrunning

items: Low rest caps max stamina, so arrive rested. A runner lost time at Kuldra because he had to rest midway with no tea.
Keep hydration high. Regen at 100 hydration is 8x the regen at 0.

body.text: Mentioned in transcripts, chat and comments (155)

**Run Notes:**

• It might be possible to get to the first wooden bridge with a good enough Zoop from the Air Anima Pillar... (After it's activated to remove the wall, of course) (~0:35 - 0:43) 

• With an insane Zoop from vines it's possible to land on the wall with the vine breaking through instead of having to run and Windjump on to it, but I've only done it once. (~1:24 - 1:38) 

• Likewise you can make it all the way to the door just past the plant with a good enough Zoop from the wall with mobs on it. (~1:41 - 1:45) 

• You can get a much better Zoop from the vine to bridge that doesn't require any dashes. (~2:13 - 2:18) 

• You can (again) get a much better Zoop from Stronghold to Keep that doesn't require any dashes. (~3:15 - 3:19) 

• Got stuck here for a second lmao. Don't do that. (~3:26) 

• Lost about a second to bonking (~3:44) and accidentally tapping shift cancelling my sprint. (~4:04) 

• The Windjump can make it all the way to the second rock (~4:35 - 4:40) instead of having to double-jump up. 

• The Rib Clip can be done much faster, if you're lucky with the Windjump and your placement, it can immediately clip you through without having to crouch/swing sword. (~5:08) 

• I'm not sure if it's better to save the surge leftover at this point and use it like I did (crossing to Kuldra), or use it earlier before Windjumping up. I'd have to recast it at the top but it could still be faster, and save me a surge from the second side of Kuldra's bridge to her face (instead of jump/dashing), as well as one for the throat. 

• The melee safespot inside the heart could probably be entered faster. 

• Overall just doing things more cleanly will produce a sub 7 considering my sum of best is 6:58.

pages.title: Tempest Shield
pages.summary: A one-minute wind shield that acts as an equipped shield and blocks all damage while raised, even unarmed. When it expires with the shield up, it knocks nearby foes down.

props.Duration: One minute; Attack level extends it (amount not stated)
props.Block: Prevents all damage while blocking, including normally unblockable attacks
props.Expiry: Wind burst knocks nearby foes down if raised

body.text: For speedrunning

items: Panic button for Kuldra phase transitions and the Phase 3 landing, where all main attacks fire at once.
Cast it before a fight. The wiki notes there is rarely time to cast mid-fight.

pages.title: The Shattered Stronghold
pages.summary: The third segment. Collect water, air, earth and fire attunements, partly from a Garou Thane or the Rat King, to charge two pylons, then cross a bridge past a Black Dragon.

props.Air attunement: Kill the air-attuned Garou Thane, or mine the foyer wall to the Rat King's Crystallised Anima
props.Earth attunement: Mine damaged wall behind fallen tower (Rat King + earth anima)
props.Fire: Fire Crystallised Anima past the earth gate; deliver to SW pylon
props.Enemies: Garou Berserkers, Giant Rats (elemental), Garou Thane, Rat King, Black Dragon

body.text: For speedrunning

items: The quick guide says to run along the stair parapet to avoid the fire.
Nanobit notes the zoop from Stronghold to Keep can be done without any dashes when it is strong enough.

pages.title: Unreal Engine 5
pages.summary: The game runs on Unreal Engine 5; the wiki says 5.6. Patch notes show collision and floor-clip problems that the engine and level geometry allow and that Jagex patches one at a time.

props.Tick / physics rate: Not published by any source found

body.text: For speedrunning

items: Collision fixes in patch notes: floor clip on teleport to Cataclysm Keep (1.0.1); falling indefinitely between rocks in Emberwood (1.0.1); falling through Zilyana's teleport platform at Kuldra (console hotfix, 23 Oct 2026).
Since 1.0 you can cast Windstep, Surge and Enchant Weapon while moving, and dodge or block cancels attacks, gathering and casts. These are designed animation-cancel windows.

No source states a server tick rate, physics step or fixed frame rate. A runner suspects that zoop strength depends on framerate (lower framerate gives a stronger zoop). This is a guess from run notes and has not been tested.

pages.title: Windstep
pages.summary: An Agility spell that makes you jump much higher and fall more slowly. It is the main movement tool in every raid route.

props.Unlock: Agility 5 (Agility unlock table). The Windstep infobox shows level 8; disputed
props.Cost: 5 Air runes (0 while Leggings of Lightness are equipped, since 1.0)
props.Window: 7 seconds to use it after casting
props.Fall: Cuts fall damage sharply but not to zero ("splat-limit")

body.text: For speedrunning

items: The quick guide uses Windstep for intended routing in Fragments of Ghornfell (bridge drops, archer parkour), The Shattered Stronghold (barrels to the air gate) and Cataclysm Keep (platforms).
The Kuldra strategy page lists an optional Phase 3 gate skip: Windstep on the broken pillar, then jump the wall. You must already have Fire anima.
In 1.0.1 Jagex "Fixed several Windstep-related skips in the Scorned Wilderness Raid". Some pre-1.0.1 routes may no longer work.
Runners use "Windjump" (Windstep jump) in raid run notes, for example reaching the second rock near Kuldra without a double jump.
Windstep height counts for Jump Attack (Death From Above!), according to the 1.0.1 notes.

body.text: Patch history

items: 0.12.1 — Runecrafting requirement raised from 7 to 8, then Windstep became an Agility spell (level 5, 5 Air runes).
[[patch:1.0|1.0]] — Castable while moving. Leggings of Lightness make it cost zero runes.
[[patch:1.0.1|1.0.1]] — Several Windstep-related skips in the Scorned Wilderness raid fixed.
